issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for getTotalNumberOfStudents: the problem statement / UML (problem_statement.md line 40) and the exercise tasks require a parameterless method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int that returns the total number of students. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75) declares public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) — i.e. it adds a boolean parameter. This API difference will confuse students and break automated checks that expect the no-argument signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent across artifacts. Option A (recommended to match the UML/tests): change the solution method to the parameterless signature public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() and implement it to return numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents; update any internal calls (e.g., getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to call the no-arg method. Option B (if the boolean parameter is intentionally required): update the problem statement, UML diagram, and template to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests): int (and update tests) so all artifacts use the same signature.
